items.title: [ECG] Monash University Australia Open Day 2026 – Singapore (Sunday, 6 September 2026)
items.author: Justin Arif Prawiradiraja
items.description:
Dear Students,
Please take note of Monash University Australia Open Day 2026 in Singapore below. If you're interested in attending, please register at your own accord via the link provided.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Monash University Australia Open Day 2026 in Singapore
This is a valuable opportunity for you to learn more about one of Australia’s leading universities, our world-class programs, and the exciting student experience we offer.
📍 Event Details
Date:
Sunday, 6 September 2026
Time:
1:00pm – 5:00pm
Venue:
Hilton Orchard, Level 5, Tembusu Room, 333 Orchard Road, Singapore 238867
At the Open Day, you will have the chance to:
Meet Monash University representatives and academics
Explore study options across diverse disciplines
Learn more about scholarships, admissions, and pathways
Gain insights into life at Monash in Melbourne
Please register your attendance via the link provided below:
👉 Invitation posters (as attached)
👉 Registration link -
https://forms.gle/1tVWkFaGtSprX6qm7
We look forward to welcoming to this exciting event.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Thank you.
Best regards,
Justin
ECG Department
